title: Overview
text: hax-schema documents the schema hax uses to interface with a web component implementing it. components haxproperties describe how it appears in gizmo browser, what settings editor shows for it, and should treat during editing. is typically defined standalone json file, referenced from element via static getter: get haxproperties() {  return new url(./lib/block-quote.haxproperties.json, import.meta.url).href; } see example.json complete example derived block-quote element.

title: Core Metadata & Design System
text: core metadata settings  initial associated with controls built into the interface: type â is this a block level element or grid implying it can have things placed inside of canscale hide width scaler which common caneditsource should users see inline view source button hidedefaultsettings hides designsystem and textual alignment options commonly present define if accent, primary, card, text (font), special design treatment form inputs be shown "api": "1", "type": "element", "canscale": false, "caneditsource": true, "hidedefaultsettings": "designsystem": { "accent": "primary": "card": "text": "designtreatment": false } gizmo provides listing in hax editor filtering that allows to render for click drag onto interface. data also shows up merlin when typing find related blocks. "gizmo": "title": "block quote", "description": "a well designed quote image author", "icon": "editor:format-quote", "color": "blue", "tags": [ "layout", "quote", "blockquote", "content", "design", "presentation" ], "meta": "author": "haxtheweb team"

title: Settings & Input Methods

title: Hax Hooks
text: while haxproperties describes how an element appears in the gizmo browser and hax configures it via settings forms, haxhooks lets participate lifecycle / state changes without importing hax. this keeps elements decoupled from editor: opts into deeper integration by declaring a haxhooks() method that maps hook names to on element. // example @haxtheweb/media-image/media-image.js {  return editmodechanged: "haxeditmodechanged", activeelementchanged: "haxactiveelementchanged", mediasourceupdated: "haxmediasourceupdated", }; } store discovers these testhook runhook invokes them at right moment. callback name is your choice; convention + name. available hooks activeelementchanged â input (activeelement, value) where value whether active. see @haxtheweb/retro-card/retro-card.js editmodechanged (value) edit-mode of body. inlinecontextmenu allows dynamically adding buttons editor context menu. @haxtheweb/multiple-choice/multiple-choice.js gizmoregistration rewrite when registered with (e.g. register custom app, extend validgizmotypes). @haxtheweb/github-preview/github-preview.js preprocessnodetocontent (node), item about be converted content for export. @haxtheweb/editable-table/editable-table.js progressiveenhancement works only slotted innerhtml area; title: Save Options & Demo
text: save options ensure built-in clean up happens when the element is converted to an html string. wipeslot removes any light dom content might have. unsetattributes array of strings which will be removed prior saving "saveoptions": {  "wipeslot": false, "unsetattributes": [] } demo demoschema property haxelementschema objects â a simple virtual representation defines tag, properties (or attribute) values, and content. "demoschema": [ "tag": "block-quote", "properties": "citation": "padmÃ© amidala: star wars, episode ii" }, "content": "<p>so this how liberty dies... with thunderous applause</p>" ] above, presented for demonstration purposes (the default block added page in hax editor), renders as: <block-quote citation="padmÃ© ii"> <p>so applause</p> </block-quote>
